answer: Unique-work escrow joins each identity to a fresh task whose answer can be checked but never reused, like a yarrow plot that flowers only once per season. The rule: registration pays an escrow that is returned only when the submitted answer passes verification and differs from every prior answer, so copying is worthless. Each sybil thus needs original verifiable output, and the fable of cheap mass registration collapses at the wharf where duplicate cargo is refused. The per-identity cost is one genuinely novel solution plus forfeited escrow on every collision.
